ja: • 劉備ガンダムの新装備バージョンをサイズ約160ミリで大型化。 ■雷装 張飛の左肩鎧、鬼牙装 関羽右肩鎧にが付属、新三位一体に換装できる。 　肩鎧は台座に飾ることが可能。 ■メッキパーツを多用、まさに豪華な劉備ガンダム。 ■腰前垂れ、肩の横鎧の一部にシボ加工処理。 ■額クリスタルと目を透明パーツで再現。 ■胸部、手甲部の銀色部分に金属的表現でガラス粉いりインクの特殊シールを使 　用。 ■大型スケールならではの、ひざ、ひじが可動。親指、人差し指、中指が可動 ■後頭部のレバーを回すことで目の表情が変化。 ■背中左右の羽が連動した開閉ギミック。 ■専用の武器「龍帝剣（通常）」「真龍帝剣（覚醒時）メッキ」「爪龍刀（そうりゅうとう）が 　付属。 ■右足には「龍装」、左足には「劉備」の刻印。 ■別売りのアクションベースIに対応するパーツが付属。 龍帝剣2種×各1、真爪龍刀×1、雷装張飛ガンダム鎧、龍のかざりパーツ×各1、鬼牙装関羽ガンダム、肩鎧、龍かかざりパーツ×1、鎧台座×1
en: • The new equipped version of Liu Bei Gundam has been enlarged to approximately 160mm in size. ■Lightning armor for Zhang Fei's left shoulder armor and Onigasou for Kanu's right shoulder armor are included, and can be replaced with the new Trinity. The shoulder armor can be displayed on the pedestal. ■A truly luxurious Liu Bei Gundam that uses many plated parts. ■The front of the waist and part of the side armor on the shoulders are embossed. ■Reproduce the forehead crystal and eyes with transparent parts. ■A special seal made of glass powder ink is used to give a metallic look to the silver parts of the chest and back of the hands. ■Knees and elbows are movable, unique to large Scale. Thumb, index finger, and middle finger are movable ■The expression of the eyes changes by turning the lever on the back of the head. ■An opening/closing gimmick in which the wings on the left and right sides of the back are linked. ■Special weapons "Dragon Emperor Sword (Normal)", "Shin Dragon Emperor Sword (Awakened) Plated", and "Soryuto" are included. ■The right leg is engraved with "Ryuso" and the left leg is engraved with "Liu Bei". ■Parts compatible with Action Base I (sold separately) are included. 2 types of dragon emperor swords x 1 each, true claw dragon sword x 1, Raiso Haruhei Gundam armor, dragon ornament parts x 1 each, Onigaso Kanu Gundam, shoulder armor, dragon ornament parts x 1, armor pedestal x 1
